purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: career interview; vocabulary (職業/許可/問い合わせ/加入/申し訳) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 若者の職業選びを、支援していますか?
lines.en: Do you support youths' career choices?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、職業の相談を受けています。
lines.style: composed counselor voice, soft warm gentle clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 問い合わせは、多いんですか?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 毎日、たくさんの問い合わせが来ます。
lines.style: gentle counselor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 団体への加入も、勧めますか?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 加入には、本人の許可を尊重します。
lines.en: For enrollment, we respect the person's consent.
lines.style: composed counselor voice, soft warm gentle clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 対応しきれない時も、ありますか?
lines.en: Are there times you can't keep up?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 申し訳ないですが、お待たせもします。
lines.en: I'm sorry to say, sometimes people wait.
lines.style: gentle counselor voice, soft warm sincere closing clarity throughout
